entries.zh: 哨（放哨，巡逻瞭望）
entries.en: to stand sentry; to patrol, to keep watch

entries.zh: 巡哨（巡逻警戒）
entries.en: to go the rounds, to make a patrol

entries.zh: 哨探（出哨侦察，探听敌情）
entries.en: to scout, to reconnoiter; to spy out

entries.zh: 操练军马（操演兵马，训练士卒战马）
entries.en: to drill troops and horses; to train soldiers and mounts

entries.zh: 巡守（巡逻守卫）
entries.en: to patrol and keep watch

entries.zh: 巡缉（巡查缉捕罪犯、私货）
entries.en: to patrol in pursuit; to hunt down and seize (criminals, contraband)

entries.zh: 守更（值更，夜间按时值守）
entries.en: to keep the night watch; to stand guard through the night watches

entries.zh: 巡更（夜间巡逻打更）
entries.en: to make the night rounds; to patrol the night watches

entries.zh: 巡看（巡查察看）
entries.en: to patrol and inspect
entries.notes: 汉栏第二字'看/眷'难辨（[疑]），据'巡'义与对音 chiẫ 取'看'，属推断。

entries.zh: 铺（铺盖，床上被褥铺垫之具）
entries.en: bedclothes, bedding; bed linen

entries.zh: 绵襦（絮棉短袄，夹棉之衣）
entries.en: padded cotton jacket; garment quilted with cotton wadding

entries.zh: 员领（圆领官袍，官员之服）
entries.en: mandarin's round-collared robe; official's gown
entries.notes: 西文 lebantar/levantar 拼写存疑；据汉栏'员领'与 Mandarín 语境定为官员圆领袍。

entries.zh: 披风（斗篷）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: cloak, cape (Spanish column damaged; gloss doubtful)
entries.notes: 西语栏[残]，'lebantar de levado'不成句；据汉栏'披风'与对音 pý hong 定为斗篷，存疑。

entries.zh: 花（泛指花，亦指玫瑰花）
entries.en: flower; rose

entries.zh: 芝（灵芝类仙草）〔与词头义不合且有抹消，释义存疑〕
entries.en: lingzhi, miraculous fungus (?) — mismatches 'rosa'; line partly struck out, gloss doubtful
entries.notes: 汉栏'芝'与词头 rosa 义不合，M 栏有抹消、后词不可辨，无从定夺，降为低置信。

entries.zh: 芳（香花，芳香之气）
entries.en: fragrance; fragrant flower; sweet scent
entries.notes: 词头仅'rosa~'带缩写符，以'芳'（香花/芳香）相对属推断。

entries.zh: 荷（莲），水中之花（字作'藕'，旁有涂改）
entries.en: lotus; flower that grows in the water (char. ou, lotus root)
entries.notes: 汉字旁有抹消笔划、M 栏首字亦抹消，据对音 liēn-ngâu 与西义'水中之花'定为莲荷，属推断。

entries.zh: 琼花（赏赐之金玫瑰，奖赏之花）
entries.en: golden rose awarded as a prize; qionghua (jadelike flower)

entries.zh: 蔷（蔷薇，'蔷薇花'之单字）
entries.en: rose of Alexandria; wild rose (qiang, as in qiangwei)

entries.zh: 含蕊（花含蕊未开，花蕾）
entries.en: unopened rose, flower bud; blossom still closed (han lui, holding its pistil)

entries.zh: 蔷薇花（蔷薇之花，即 rosa de alexandria）
entries.en: Alexandrian rose; wild-rose blossom (qiangwei hua)
